OurTeam.title: Our Team
OurTeam.subtitle: Dedicated experts. Shared vision. Cultivating sustainable seed systems across Africa.
OurTeam.aline_bio: Aline is an experienced seed company practitioner, teacher, writer, manager, strategist, and entrepreneur, who has worked on seed systems in Africa since 2007. Aline has worked in the crop seed industry in the US and Africa for close to 30 years, including nine years as the CEO of a large US crop seed company. As the Founding Director of Agri Experience, Aline is highly committed to building and supporting local teams to catalyze growth and opportunity in Africa, and remains available as an advisor to the company.
OurTeam.aline_projects: Seed Systems, Crop Seed Industry, Strategic Advising, Entrepreneurship
OurTeam.mulemia_bio: Mulemia Maina who leads the team, is a distinguished leader in Africa’s seed sector with over 25 years of expertise in the seed and agricultural sector, spanning public-private partnerships, enterprise development, strategic programming, and development partner relations. She has managed over 350 projects across 22 countries, collaborating with governments, regional bodies, and over 100 seed companies to strengthen policy, capacity, and last-mile delivery. Passionate about empowering farmers, Mulemia champions improved technologies and transformative seed system initiatives to enhance livelihoods across sub-Saharan Africa. She is fluent in English, French, and Kiswahili.
OurTeam.mulemia_projects: Seed Systems, AGRA Grants, Rockefeller Foundation
OurTeam.jayne_bio: Jayne leads the finance and administration portfolio, overseeing the firm's financial management, governance, and administrative operations. With over 30 years of experience in finance and administration, she manages donor and program funds and brings expertise in grant management, financial compliance, internal controls, donor reporting, and financial governance. She provides strategic financial leadership that ensures sound stewardship, operational excellence, and the highest standards of integrity and accountability across the organization.
OurTeam.ronald_bio: Ronald serves as technical lead and is a digital agriculture specialist with over 13 years of experience in seed systems and digital transformation. He specializes in designing innovative digital platforms, databases, dashboards, as well as information systems that strengthen seed systems while advancing agricultural value chains across Africa. His expertise spans technical studies, client advisory, policy and regulatory reform, together with seed systems analytics enabling governments, development partners and private sector organizations to make evidence-based investment and strategic decisions. Ronald has developed impactful national and regional seed-focused tools including SMS based digital feedback solutions that empower farmers, agrodealers, seed companies, as well as regulators in decision making.
OurTeam.denis_bio: Denis is a young and dynamic project monitoring specialist who supports client related activities with a focus on general research, documentation, record keeping, project monitoring, data collection and analysis.
OurTeam.denis_projects: PSTA-5 Indicators, Data Analysis, Dashboard Development
OurTeam.moses_bio: Moses serves as a data analyst, supporting data-driven decision-making through advanced analytics, data management, and visualization. With over 7 years of experience in data analysis and digital information systems, he specializes in data collection, quality assurance, statistical analysis, dashboard development, and business intelligence. Moses transforms complex datasets into actionable insights that enable governments, development partners, and private sector organizations to make evidence-based decisions and improve program performance.
OurTeam.moses_projects: Quality Assurance, Testing Processes, User Acceptance Testing
OurTeam.claire_bio: Claire provides high-level administrative and logistics support to ensure seamless company operations. She supports technical operations including asset management, budget coordination, process optimization and keeps operations well aligned by managing workflows and complex schedules. Her dedication to operational excellence and organizational effectiveness enables the team to focus on strategic priorities and ensures that company’s objectives are met with precision, supporting the broader mission and driving sustainable success.
OurTeam.nicholas_bio: An integral part of the team, providing essential logistical and office support.

OurImpact.journey_desc: Over 30 years of seed sector experience, accelerating growth and sustainable seed systems across Africa.
OurImpact.achievements_desc: Our consulting work has led to major advancements in seed systems and farmer empowerment across the continent. Here is a look at some of our transformative programs.
OurImpact.kenya_desc: We partnered with MoA, KEPHIS, seed companies, and STAK to make significant improvements in the Kenyan seed sector.
OurImpact.k1_desc: Enabled authorization of private seed inspection, gazetting over 40 inspectors and 17 analysts. Piloted "standard seed" to increase non-maize and non-hybrid crops.
OurImpact.k2_desc: Introduced scratch-off labels, reducing counterfeits by over 40% and label costs by 85%, empowering farmers to confirm seed quality.
OurImpact.k3_desc: Revitalized STAK, growing membership by over 30%. Created County Agrodealer Associations in 10 counties and trained agrodealers through Mazao forums.
OurImpact.k4_desc: Kenya's innovations spread! Scratch labels were adopted in Nigeria, Tanzania, and Uganda, and Tanzania benchmarked Kenya's private inspection model.
OurImpact.tz_desc: A six-year initiative aimed at modernizing three key public institutions to enhance the delivery of quality seed to farmers and foster a private sector-oriented industry.
OurImpact.t1: Strengthened Institutional Capacity: Established the National Planning and Coordination Unit for effective oversight.
OurImpact.t2: Streamlined Certification: Reduced delays and increased efficiency with a fully digitized certification system.
OurImpact.t3: Enhanced Laboratory Services: Renovated two labs, cutting sample wait times by over 50% and expanding seed variety availability.
OurImpact.t4: Decentralized Quality Assurance: Recognized authorized private seed inspectors and laboratory analysts.
OurImpact.t5: Improved Information Flow: Deployed a digitized platform for accurate seed demand forecasting.
OurImpact.cta_desc: Join us in transforming agricultural systems and improving livelihoods across Africa.

1.title: SDG 1: No Poverty
1.aspect: Improved farmer productivity, seed enterprise growth, and rural income opportunities.
1.examples: Training seed companies, agrodealers, outgrowers and CBOs to improve seed production, marketing, business management and access to quality seed.

2.title: SDG 2: Zero Hunger
2.aspect: Strengthened food security through wider access to quality seed and improved crop varieties.
2.examples: MbeguChoice, Seed Sector Platform Kenya, standard certified seed class, farmer demos, and training on variety selection and certified seed use.

3.title: SDG 3: Good Health and Well-being
3.aspect: Indirect contribution to household nutrition and well-being through improved agricultural productivity and food availability.
3.examples: Support for improved varieties, farmer awareness, and production of diverse crops under standard certified seed arrangements.

5.title: SDG 5: Gender Equality
5.aspect: Supported more inclusive access to training, seed information, and market opportunities.
5.examples: Digital tools and county-level agrodealer networks reduce information barriers for women farmers, youth and small enterprises.

8.title: SDG 8: Decent Work and Economic Growth
8.aspect: Strengthened seed-sector businesses, agrodealer enterprises, associations and local employment opportunities.
8.examples: Business development services for seed companies, training of over 3,000 agrodealers, and formation of 16 county agrodealer associations.

13.title: SDG 13: Climate Action
13.aspect: Improved resilience through climate-smart agriculture, variety choice, and locally adapted seed systems.
13.examples: Climate-smart agrodealer-led demos, variety positioning, farmer field days, and promotion of locally suitable improved varieties.

17.title: SDG 17: Partnerships for the Goals
17.aspect: Built partnerships across government, private sector, associations, development partners, research bodies and farmers.
17.examples: Collaboration with MoA, KEPHIS, STAK, KALRO, seed companies, agrodealers, county officers, AGRA, CRS, Gatsby Africa and other partners.

OurResults.title: Our Results
OurResults.subtitle: The breadth and impact of our work are highlighted in selected reports and examples of assignments.
OurResults.downloads_desc: Below are downloadable versions of client reports and case studies that are in the public domain. Additional significant client work has been completed but is not available to the public per the terms of client engagement.
OurResults.a1_title: Bringing accurate and transparent information to seed sector stakeholders
OurResults.a1_challenge: Kenya Markets Trust identified a lack of accessible, decision-ready information for the crop seed sector, limiting investment and growth.
OurResults.a1_solution: Agri Experience surveyed stakeholders, partnered with KEPHIS, KALRO, and STAK, and built a comprehensive, searchable platform with mapping and filters.
OurResults.a1_benefit: The platform has 1,200+ repeat users and supports seed companies, analysts, and regulators; STAK assumed responsibility for ongoing stewardship.
OurResults.a2_title: Educating crop breeders about crop seed commercialisation
OurResults.a2_challenge: WACCI needed its PhD breeding program to prepare scientists to bring improved varieties to farmers at scale.
OurResults.a2_solution: Agri Experience delivered Seed Business Management training on production, quality, marketing, profitability, and the role of breeders.
OurResults.a2_benefit: Graduates are better equipped to work with commercial partners and deliver real-world farmer impact at scale.
OurResults.a3_title: Introducing new drought tolerant maize varieties into the market
OurResults.a3_challenge: A client needed to support private sector licensees to rapidly produce, market, and distribute new drought tolerant maize varieties.
OurResults.a3_solution: Agri Experience surveyed seed companies, clarified information needs, and trained senior staff to think like private sector seed companies.
OurResults.a3_benefit: The first-generation rollout was rapid and successful, enabling strong momentum for subsequent variety releases.
OurResults.cta_desc: Contact our team to discuss your seed sector priorities and potential collaborations.

ClientAdvisory.cs_title: KEPHIS Regulatory Modernization: Private Seed Inspection & Standard Seed Pilot
ClientAdvisory.cs_desc1: In partnership with the Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service (KEPHIS), the Ministry of Agriculture, and the Seed Trade Association of Kenya (STAK), Agri Experience provided strategic advisory to unlock critical regulatory bottlenecks in Kenya's seed certification ecosystem.
ClientAdvisory.cs_desc2: By structuring policy frameworks for private inspector authorization and piloting the 'standard seed' class, the intervention decentralized quality assurance, expanded seed supply for non-hybrid crops, and established a sustainable model that later informed regional regulatory benchmarking across East Africa.
ClientAdvisory.cs_pillar1_desc: Structured the operational and institutional framework enabling KEPHIS to formally authorize and gazette private seed inspectors and laboratory analysts within seed companies, drastically expanding inspection capacity.
ClientAdvisory.cs_pillar2_desc: Designed and piloted standard seed certification protocols for non-hybrid and food security crops, establishing pragmatic field requirements while upholding mandatory germination and purity quality standards.
ClientAdvisory.cs_pillar3_desc: Bridged public regulatory mandates with private sector capabilities, fostering sustained alignment between KEPHIS and the Seed Trade Association of Kenya (STAK) to operationalize co-regulation.
ClientAdvisory.cs_pillar4_desc: Generated an empirical evidence base demonstrating the viability of private inspection authorization, serving as a regional benchmark for neighboring seed authorities across East Africa.

ProjectImplementation.hero_subtitle: Turning Agricultural Strategy into Field Reality
ProjectImplementation.hero_desc1: Bridging the gap between agricultural strategy and field-level execution. Agri Experience executes complex, multi-stakeholder programs that deliver tangible and sustainable results on the ground, benefiting permanent actors and farmers.
ProjectImplementation.hero_desc2: Our implementation practice combines deep technical expertise with rigorous project management to execute seed sector interventions, agrodealer capacity programs, and technology deployments across Sub-Saharan Africa.
ProjectImplementation.pm_desc: We treat implementation as a discipline. Every project is guided by structured methodologies to ensure on-time delivery, stakeholder alignment, and verifiable impact.
ProjectImplementation.pm_step1_desc: We quickly move from concept to detailed operational planning. This includes mobilizing teams, defining clear KPIs, establishing reporting structures, and aligning all stakeholders around shared objectives.
ProjectImplementation.pm_step2_desc: Field realities often diverge from boardroom plans. We utilize agile management principles, allowing us to pivot strategies based on real-time feedback from the ground while maintaining focus on the ultimate goals.
ProjectImplementation.pm_step3_desc: Implementation is meaningless without measurement. We embed M&E into our daily operations, utilizing digital tools to track progress, ensure quality assurance, and provide transparent reporting to partners.
ProjectImplementation.pm_step4_desc: We don't just execute; we build local capability. Our projects are designed to transfer knowledge and operational skills to local institutions, ensuring that impact sustains long after our direct involvement ends.
ProjectImplementation.cs_title: Enhancing the Seed Systems in Tanzania (ESSETA) – A turning point for Tanzania’s Seed Sector
ProjectImplementation.cs_desc1: Over the past five years, Tanzania’s seed sector has recorded significant progress, driven in large part by Agri Experience’s leadership in implementing ESSETA, a Gates Foundation-funded initiative, which aimed to improve the efficiency, coordination, and performance of key public institutions responsible for delivering quality seed to farmers while fostering a sustainable, private sector-led seed industry.
ProjectImplementation.cs_desc2: Interventions included the development of a digital seed sector platform to strengthen information sharing and improve seed demand forecasting, the renovation and equipping of two strategic seed testing laboratories, and support for a decentralized seed quality assurance system that enables authorized private seed inspectors and laboratory analysts. These efforts have contributed to stronger national planning and improved information exchange within the Ministry of Agriculture, supporting the continued growth of Tanzania’s seed sector.
ProjectImplementation.cs_pillar1_desc: Renovation and equipping of two strategic seed testing laboratories in Morogoro and the Southern Highlands, cutting sample result wait times by over 50% and expanding availability of diverse, high-quality seed varieties tailored to farmers’ needs.
ProjectImplementation.cs_pillar2_desc: Development of a digital seed sector platform to streamline certification workflows, enhance data capture, and enable accurate seed demand forecasting and future planning.
ProjectImplementation.cs_pillar3_desc: Decentralization of national seed quality assurance through the authorization and deployment of private seed inspectors and accredited private laboratory analysts.
ProjectImplementation.cs_pillar4_desc: Establishment of the National Planning and Coordination Unit within the Ministry of Agriculture, strengthening information exchange, policy alignment, and national seed distribution oversight.
ProjectImplementation.cta_desc: Whether you need to manage a national agricultural survey, deploy a digital platform, or coordinate a multi-county training program, our team has the proven capability to deliver.

Events.method_title: How We Design & Deliver High-Impact Convenings
Events.method_desc: Every Agri Experience roundtable, field trip, and technical forum follows a disciplined four-stage practice methodology.
Events.step_1_desc: We ground every convening in field data and scoping studies so participants debate concrete evidence and actionable policy options rather than abstract generalities.
Events.step_2_desc: We assemble the exact decision-makers required to unlock progress — pairing national regulators and breeders with private seed enterprises and agrodealer leaders.
Events.step_3_desc: Our senior partners moderate discussions with candor and neutrality, structuring field visits and working groups so every voice contributes to practical consensus.
Events.step_4_desc: A convening is only as valuable as what happens next. We document clear action roadmaps, synthesis briefs, and regulatory follow-up milestones.
